evals.name: trivial-fix-path
evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the error message for the close command and get it PR-ready.
evals.expected_output: A trivial contract, a one-line change, check.sh and the relevant driver run, a mechanical review-gate pass, then a stop for human approval before ship.
assertions: Skips shaping and deep lenses for the trivial class
Runs observe.sh and fresh.sh before claiming done
Stops for explicit approval before commit or push

evals.name: unreproduced-bug-stops
evals.prompt: Users say snapshot drops iframes. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The driver runs before any change; when it passes on the reported behavior the run stops and reports the bug as not reproduced instead of changing code.
assertions: Does not write a fix for an unreproduced bug
Reports the reproduction attempt with evidence paths

evals.name: drift-before-promotion
evals.prompt: Review passed yesterday; I pushed one more commit. Open the PR now.
evals.expected_output: gate.sh drift fails against the reviewed patch-id and the run returns to review instead of opening the PR.
assertions: Runs gate.sh drift with the reviewed patch-id
Does not open the PR on a stale verdict
